items.title: Pay invoice for property 'registration' entry
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 01.12.2026. This is a company letter (no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies); the date is taken as printed. 01.12.2026 falls on a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NRW, so no shift is needed. To arrive by then, a bank transfer should be sent about one business day earlier (§ 675s BGB), i.e. by 2026-11-30, but the due date itself is 2026-12-01.

warnings: This looks like a known German scam/misleading-offer pattern: a private company styling itself 'Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH' with a logo resembling an official seal sends an unsolicited document formatted like an invoice for a property 'registration', but the small print says 'Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot... Ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande. Die Eintragung erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch' — i.e. it is only an offer for a worthless private listing, unrelated to the official Grundbuch (land register), and paying it creates a contract you did not ask for.
There is no genuine legal obligation to pay this; it should not be treated as a bill from the actual land registry (Grundbuchamt) or any authority.

The IBAN (DE59 5007 0010 0005 5707 00) is formally valid as a German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not confirm who owns the account or that the service is legitimate; do not pay without independently verifying the sender.
Recommend not paying and, if desired, reporting this letter to consumer protection (Verbraucherzentrale) or the police as a suspected misleading commercial offer.
